current_arc: The Monsoon Car Ride & Secret Pouch

history.title: തിരിച്ചുവരവ് (The Homecoming)
history.summary: After two long years of waiting, Reenu stands anxiously with her friend Amal at Kochi CIAL arrival terminal. Sachin emerges through the sliding glass doors, leading to an emotional, tearful reunion. However, Sachin nervously clutches a secret leather pouch from London.
history.cliffhanger: As Sachin holds Reenu close, his eyes reveal a hidden anxiety while his fingers tightly clutch a secret, unopened leather pouch.

history.title: മഴയും ചില രഹസ്യങ്ങളും (Rain and Some Secrets)
history.summary: Stepping outside Kochi CIAL airport into a sudden heavy monsoon shower, Sachin, Reenu, and Amal rush through the rain with their luggage to Amal's car. As they drive through the rain-drenched Kochi streets with wipers swishing, Reenu notices Sachin's nervous protectiveness over his London leather pouch. Sachin tries to speak, but a sudden braking causes the pouch to slip and slide deep under the car seat, leading to a tense and suspicious moment.
history.cliffhanger: The mysterious London leather pouch slips from Sachin's hand and slides deep under the front passenger seat. As Sachin frantically reaches down trying to hide it, Reenu looks at him with growing suspicion, asking what he is hiding.
